es.summary: Proteína recombinante que reemplaza la deficiencia de inhibidor de C1, reduciendo la actividad del sistema del complemento en ataques de angioedema hereditario.
key_points: Se administra por vía intravenosa para ataques agudos de HAE.
Contraindicado en pacientes con alergia a productos derivados de conejo.
Vigilar signos de reacción alérgica inmediata.
Monitorear la vía aérea y la presión arterial durante y después de la infusión.

mechanism: Reemplaza el inhibidor natural de C1, disminuyendo la activación del complemento.
Reduce la generación de bradiquinina, principal mediador del edema.
Restablece la regulación de la vía de la cascada del complemento.
indications: Tratamiento de ataques agudos de angioedema hereditario en adultos y adolescentes.
Uso en pacientes con deficiencia funcional de inhibidor de C1.
contraindications: Alergia conocida a conejos o productos derivados de conejo.
Reacciones hipersensibles graves previas a preparaciones de inhibidor de C1.
adverse_effects: Edema de lengua o vías respiratorias (grave)
interactions: Puede potenciar reacciones alérgicas con otros productos de plasma.
Uso concomitante con inmunoglobulinas puede aumentar riesgo de reacciones.
nursing_care: Verificar ausencia de alergia a conejos antes de la infusión.
Obtener acceso venoso de calibre adecuado y preparar equipo de reanimación.
Monitorear presión arterial, frecuencia cardíaca y saturación de O₂ cada 5‑15 min.
Evaluar la vía aérea y grado de edema facial y faríngeo durante la infusión.
Suspender la infusión y notificar al médico si aparecen signos de anafilaxia.
patient_teaching: Informar que el medicamento se administra por vía intravenosa y puede causar sensación de calor.
Explicar la importancia de reportar cualquier dificultad para respirar o hinchazón súbita.
Recomendar evitar factores desencadenantes del HAE (estrés, trauma, ciertos medicamentos).
Indicar que debe acudir al servicio de urgencias si se presenta un nuevo ataque.

care_plans.diagnosis: Riesgo de déficit de volumen de líquidos
outcomes: Volumen intravascular mantenido: peso estable (±0.5 kg) en 24 h
Signos de edema reducidos en 2 h después del tratamiento

interventions.action: Monitorizar signos vitales (PA, FC, SatO₂) cada 5‑15 min durante la infusión
interventions.rationale: Detectar hipotensión o deterioro de la vía aérea tempranamente

interventions.action: Evaluar la vía aérea y registrar grado de edema facial y faríngeo
Administrar inhibidor de C1 esterasa según prescripción y observar la velocidad de infusión
interventions.rationale: Restaurar la regulación del complemento y reducir el edema

interventions.action: Mantener acceso venoso y equipo de intubación listo
interventions.rationale: Estar preparado para intervención de emergencia si ocurre colapso de la vía aérea

interventions.action: Documentar respuesta al tratamiento y cualquier reacción adversa
interventions.rationale: Facilitar la continuidad del cuidado y la evaluación de la efectividad

en.summary: Recombinant protein that replaces C1 inhibitor deficiency, reducing complement system activity during hereditary angioedema attacks.
key_points: Administered intravenously for acute HAE attacks.
Contraindicated in patients with rabbit product allergy.
Monitor for immediate allergic reaction signs.
Monitor airway and blood pressure during and after infusion.

mechanism: Replaces natural C1 inhibitor, decreasing complement activation.
Reduces bradykinin generation, the main edema mediator.
Restores regulation of the complement cascade pathway.
indications: Treatment of acute hereditary angioedema attacks in adults and adolescents.
Use in patients with functional C1 inhibitor deficiency.
contraindications: Known allergy to rabbits or rabbit-derived products.
Severe prior hypersensitivity reactions to C1 inhibitor preparations.
interactions: May potentiate allergic reactions with other plasma products.
Concurrent use with immunoglobulins may increase reaction risk.
nursing_care: Verify absence of rabbit allergy before infusion.
Obtain appropriate venous access and prepare resuscitation equipment.
Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and O₂ saturation every 5‑15 min.
Assess airway and degree of facial and pharyngeal edema during infusion.
Stop infusion and notify physician if anaphylaxis signs appear.
patient_teaching: Inform that the medication is given IV and may cause a feeling of warmth.
Explain importance of reporting any breathing difficulty or sudden swelling.
Recommend avoiding HAE triggers (stress, trauma, certain medications).
Advise to seek emergency care if a new attack occurs.

outcomes: Intravascular volume maintained: stable weight (±0.5 kg) in 24 h
Reduced edema signs within 2 h post-treatment

interventions.action: Monitor vital signs (BP, HR, SpO₂) every 5‑15 min during infusion
interventions.rationale: Detect hypotension or airway deterioration early

interventions.action: Assess airway and record facial and pharyngeal edema severity
Administer C1 esterase inhibitor per prescription and observe infusion rate
interventions.rationale: Restore complement regulation and reduce edema

interventions.action: Maintain venous access and keep intubation equipment ready
interventions.rationale: Be prepared for emergency airway intervention if collapse occurs

interventions.action: Document treatment response and any adverse reactions
interventions.rationale: Facilitate continuity of care and effectiveness evaluation

key_points.0.quote: RUCONEST is a recombinant analogue of human complement component 1 esterase inhibitor for intravenous injection.

key_points.1.quote: RUCONEST is contraindicated in patients with a history of allergy to rabbits or rabbit-derived products.

key_points.2.quote: Advise patients to immediately report : Signs and symptoms of allergic hypersensitivity reactions, such as hives, urticaria, tightness of the chest, wheezing, hypotension and/or anaphylaxis experienced during or after injection of RUCONEST [ see WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS/Hypersensitivity ( 5 )].

sections.mechanism.0.quote: The primary function of C1INH is to regulate the activation of the complement and contact system pathways.

sections.mechanism.2.quote: The primary function of C1INH is to regulate the activation of the complement and contact system pathways.

sections.indications.0.quote: RUCONEST is a C1 esterase inhibitor [recombinant] indicated for the treatment of acute attacks in adult and adolescent patients with hereditary angioedema (HAE).

sections.indications.1.quote: HAE patients have low levels of endogenous or functional C1INH.

sections.contraindications.0.quote: Known or suspected allergy to rabbits and rabbit-derived products.

sections.contraindications.1.quote: RUCONEST is contraindicated in patients with a history of life-threatening immediate hypersensitivity reactions to C1 esterase inhibitor preparations, including anaphylaxis.

sections.adverse_effects.0.quote: The most common adverse reactions (≥ 2%) reported in all clinical trials were headache, nausea, and diarrhea.

sections.adverse_effects.1.quote: The most common adverse reactions (≥ 2%) reported in all clinical trials were headache, nausea, and diarrhea.

sections.adverse_effects.3.quote: The serious adverse reaction reported in clinical trials was anaphylactic reaction.

sections.nursing_care.0.quote: RUCONEST is contraindicated in patients with a history of allergy to rabbits or rabbit-derived products.

sections.patient_teaching.1.quote: Call your healthcare provider or the emergency department immediately if you have any of the following symptoms after receiving RUCONEST: wheezing difficulty breathing chest tightness turning blue (look at lips and gums) fast heartbeat swelling faintness rash hives
